regions.merged_text: I hope this finds you all well with hopeful outlook. I want to thank you for your kindness recently received - the writing materials, etc and especially the very nice little "Storm of St. Therese's Glory". I surely find it very interest- ing. This favor came Monday - day before-yesterday. Many thanks too for the beautiful boquet just came in this afternoon. God bless you. May He speed up your plans and perfect undertakings!
